_doc: COVID-stress backtest of CCRC detector framework. Snapshot 2019-12-31 → outcomes 2020-12-31 / 2021-12-31 / 2022-12-31. Universe = 19 CA CCRC obligated groups + standalones derived from data/ca_ccrc_universe.json (rolled up). BLIND DISCIPLINE: sources dated 2019-2022 (or earlier) only. Where we leak into 2023+ for context only, we flag.
key_notes: HumanGood California Obligated Group (HGCOG) was formed Aug 2019 with Series 2019 bond issuance — at snapshot 2019-12-31, the OG existed but only just
Front Porch + Covia merger announced June 2020, effective April 1, 2021. At snapshot 2019-12-31 these are TWO SEPARATE OBLIGORS, each with separate Fitch A- ratings

California-Nevada Methodist Homes (CNMH) Ch 11 filed March 16, 2021 — CHFFA-issued bonds $32.92M (2015), Lake Park Oakland + Forest Hill Pacific Grove. NOT in our 2025-era universe (sold to Pacifica 2022) but a COVID-era CA CCRC default near-miss for our universe.
Sequoia Living lost 31% of Viamonte deposits during 2020 COVID delay; opened December 2020 — material adverse event

Sector context: Fitch assigned DETERIORATING outlook to CCRC sector starting in 2022 (cited 2 consecutive years 2022, 2023). 2020-2021 was 'pandemic pressure' but not yet sector-deteriorating outlook.
Industrywide IL occupancy: Q4 2019 ~91% → Q1 2021 trough ~80% → Q4 2021 ~85.7% (entrance fee IL specifically). Pacific region held up best (~90.9% Q4 2021).

ccrc_il_occupancy_industrywide.source: NIC MAP CCRC Care Segment Performance reports

sector_macro_context.default_rate_dec_2021: ~8% of $41B outstanding senior-care bond face = ~$3.3B in default, ~25% of all defaulted muni debt
sector_macro_context.ziegler_2021_finding: FY2021 net operating margin negative for CCRCs first time in 5 years (excl. govt aid)
sector_macro_context.fitch_sector_outlook_2020: Negative — life plan communities under pressure amidst coronavirus (March 2020)
sector_macro_context.fitch_sector_outlook_2021: Improving but cautious — most rated CA names affirmed Stable

ca_specific_ccrc_default.name: California-Nevada Methodist Homes (CNMH)
ca_specific_ccrc_default.outcome: Ch 11 → sold to Pacifica Companies LLC Feb 2022 for $34M

blind_discipline_warning: All per-obligor files use only sources dated 2019-2022 or earlier. Where 2024-2025 articles are cited, they are flagged as 'context_only_post_window'. The 2024-2025 trajectory IS NOT used to compute outcome_class — only ratings actions / events occurring within window count.
